$comment: Who can use BizTech Control Tower, and what they may do.
Signing in at all requires a verified @ubcbiztech.com Google account —
the same rule bt-web-v2 uses to decide admin (src/queries/user.ts).
Anyone in the domain who is not listed below gets 'viewer': read-only.
Write access — rollback, and every mutation added later — requires an
explicit entry here. Granting access is a pull request, and revoking it
is a pull request. There is no admin UI on purpose: the audit trail is
viewer    read everything. The default for the domain.
deployer  roll back a service on any environment.
admin     everything a deployer can do, plus future settings.
Emails are compared lowercased. Add a 'note' saying who someone is and
which term they hold the role for, so the next exec knows what to prune.
